label: DEMO
description: Deterministic four-agent AEP v0.1 fixture set for JCC Demo Mode (S-05). Every envelope carries a FIXED timestamp, a fixed session_id and a fixed delivery_id, so replaying this manifest into an empty database reproduces the SAME assessments, the SAME actions, the SAME directive ids, the SAME evidence hashes, the SAME session state and the SAME audit sequence. No third-party credential is read or required: the chain runs ingest -> AEP -> state -> assessment -> policy -> directive -> audit -> UI entirely offline. ONE BOUNDED EXCEPTION, measured 2026-09-26: the ingest path dates its own writes from the wall clock (packages/jcc_core/core.py line 223 `now = time.time()`, reaching the directive timestamp at line 297, the session updated_at at line 327 and the audit timestamp at line 340). The audit entry_hash (packages/jcc_core/audit.py line 185) hashes that timestamp, and each row's prev_hash links to the prior row's entry_hash, so timestamp, entry_hash and prev_hash are NOT reproducible across replays. They are declared, sourced and hash-pinned in the volatile_fields block of artifacts/acceptance/demo_e2e.json, and a replay that differs ANYWHERE ELSE is a failure. Earlier revisions of this file claimed byte-identical audit rows; that claim was false and has been withdrawn.
